How the orchestrator sequences the containers when the host is not Prebid
The host calls once with the bid request AND the bid response it already holds, so all four stages run,
and the host applies the complete stage-ordered list to both documents itself.

ORCHESTRATOR (EKS) ONE REQUEST, FOUR SEQUENTIAL STAGES
Containers within a stage run in parallel. Between stages the orchestrator applies the returned mutations to a working copy of the bid request,
so each stage reads what the stage before it wrote. Budget: each stage gets the time remaining under tmax, floored at 10 ms.
